	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_regional_buldor_recalled > 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_regional_buldor_recalled = -1 }

	else = {
		add_to_variable = { zin_regional_buldor_contracts = -1 }
		add_manpower = 2000
		clamp_variable = {
			var = zin_regional_buldor_contracts
			min = 0
		}
	}
}

zin_regional_buldor_recall_contract = {
	add_to_variable = { zin_regional_buldor_contracts = -1 }
	add_manpower = 2000
	add_to_variable = { zin_regional_buldor_recalled = 1 }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = zin_regional_buldor_contracts
		min = 0
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zin_regional_buldor_last_employer }
		var:zin_regional_buldor_last_employer = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = zin_regional_buldor_company_contract }
				remove_ideas = zin_regional_buldor_company_contract
			}
		}
		clear_variable = zin_regional_buldor_last_employer
	}
}
